The '''Alderaan Biotics facility''' served as a base for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The New Republic used it to stage [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|operations]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
